name: SPY Morning Mean Reversion (9:45 Entry)
description: Intraday mean reversion strategy that buys SPY at 9:45 AM when price is down from the 9:30 open, holds until 10:30 AM same day
source:
# SPY Morning Mean Reversion (9:45 Entry)
# Buy SPY at 9:45 AM when price is down from 9:30 open, exit at 10:30 AM

# Data source - 15 minute bars
src = market_data_source(timeframe=15Min)()
close = src.c

# Get session window for US equity regular trading hours (9:30-16:00 ET)
# This gives us the session open price at 9:30 AM
session = session_window(session=Session(start="09:30", end="16:00", tz="America/New_York"))()
session_open = session.open

# Extract hour and minute from bar timestamp in Eastern Time
hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone="America/New_York")(index())
minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone="America/New_York")(index())

# Entry signal: 9:45 AM ET and price below session open (mean reversion setup)
is_945 = hour == 9 and minute == 45
price_below_open = close < session_open
entry_signal = is_945 and price_below_open

# Exit signal: 10:30 AM ET (fixed time exit)
is_1030 = hour == 10 and minute == 30
exit_signal = is_1030

# Hold signal - maintain long position from entry until exit
held_long = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# Execution zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# 100% allocation per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# Event Marker: Entry Signal
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Entry Signal (9:45 AM)",
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Time", type=CardRenderType.TimestampFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Session Open", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Entry", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True)
        ]
    )
)(index(), close, session_open, entry_signal)

# Event Marker: Exit Signal
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Exit Signal (10:30 AM)",
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Time", type=CardRenderType.TimestampFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Exit", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True)
        ]
    )
)(index(), close, exit_signal)
